name: Amsterdam

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after round 12 (phase IV skipped)

categories.label: Prestige points on track (before penalties)
categories.labelVi: Điểm uy tín trên track (trước phạt)
categories.hint: Points on the scoring track from play (deliveries, fast-delivery bonuses).

categories.label: Penalty tokens
categories.hint: Count all penalty tokens (include 1 per card still below the board). 1st -3, 2nd -5, each further -7.

categories.label: End-game scoring cards
categories.hint: Total points from active cards with the game-end icon.

categories.label: Largest connected group of crests
categories.labelVi: Nhóm huy hiệu liền kề lớn nhất
categories.hint: 3 points per crest in your largest group connected by bridges.

categories.label: District majorities
categories.hint: Points from face-up District tiles for most crests; tie splits the two positions' points, rounded down.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who is further ahead on the Amstel canal wins.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Người đi xa hơn trên kênh Amstel thắng.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only a third-party rulebook transcription (RulesPal) could be reached; official PDF/BGG pages were not accessible, so values are not verified against the printed rulebook. Expansions (Specialized Workers, Secret Orders, Black-Marketeer, Extra Market Tiles) and solo TOM not modelled; Secret Orders add extra final points. Penalty cumulative table: 1:-3, 2:-8, 3:-15, 4:-22.
